sentence: This project builds a microscope that uses quantum imaging to study live cells without markers.
This project studies how a forest recovering from a wildfire changes the stability of burnt hillslopes against landslides caused by wetting.
This project studies whether draining trapped floodwaters through shallow channels helps marsh birds that nest in tidal marshes.
This project tests how salt changes the way sunlight breaks down dissolved organic matter in freshwater samples.
This project focuses on protecting the hardware and software of airborne systems in aviation and aerospace cybersecurity.
This project uses deep learning to design small peptides from prebiotic amino acids and tests whether they can transfer electrons.
This project scales up a way to make peptides at lower cost using microbial cell factories.
This project builds a data platform to develop and test AI models that study light curves of variable stars.
This project studies how transition metal complexes react and break down after being deposited onto surfaces.
This project studies how digital technology and online connections affect the safety, privacy and social life of children and adolescents.
This project studies how chemical changes to chromatin control gene silencing and the number and types of neurons in the developing mouse cortex.
This project studies how well organic matter in the shells of planktic foraminifera is preserved as the shells sink to the seafloor.
This project studies how a molecular switch on a surface changes how liquids wet the surface under light and applied voltages.
This project plans a center that will integrate electronics and intelligence into ultrasound systems for sensing, imaging, therapy and drug delivery.
